ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white dominates the central lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous 10-30 pixel wide band along the trailing edge. Distinct black vertical streaks are located on the right lobe. Dark grey circular mottling is localized along the inner boundary of the black trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from approximately 5 to 15 pixels; serrations are most acute at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A complex curve featuring a convex mid-lobe trajectory transitioning into a concave sweep towards the tapered, upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of roughly circular, low-contrast grey rings (rosettes) concentrated on the distal left tip and lining the black trailing edge margin of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, near-parallel vertical dark linear streaks localized in the medial region of the right lobe's high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical barnacle-like protrusions on the superior distal tip of the left lobe; irregular jagged morphology on the leftmost trailing edge corner suggesting past trauma or heavy colonization.
